context: Tests whether the agent correctly swizzles a Docusaurus Footer component using the wrap workflow: listing components first, choosing --wrap over --eject, placing the file in src/theme/Footer/, importing the original via @theme-original/Footer, adding custom content, and validating with npm run build.

checklist.name: Swizzle with --wrap
checklist.description: The swizzled Footer file uses the wrap pattern: it imports the original Footer from '@theme-original/Footer' and renders it, rather than containing a full copy of the original Footer source (which would indicate --eject was used)

checklist.name: Correct file location
checklist.description: The customized footer component is placed under src/theme/Footer/ (i.e., the file path is src/theme/Footer/index.js or src/theme/Footer/index.tsx within the Docusaurus project)

checklist.name: Import via @theme-original
checklist.description: The wrapper file contains an import statement importing the original Footer from '@theme-original/Footer'

checklist.name: Props passed through
checklist.description: The wrapper renders the original <Footer> component and passes props through (e.g., <Footer {...props} /> or equivalent)

checklist.name: Custom content added
checklist.description:
The wrapper component adds custom content (e.g., a
,

, or similar element) outside/below the original

render — not just a stub that renders the original unchanged

checklist.name: Build succeeded
checklist.description: The file build-log.txt exists in the workspace and contains text indicating the Docusaurus build succeeded (e.g., 'Success!' or 'Generated static files')

checklist.name: Lowest-level component swizzled
checklist.description: The agent swizzled Footer specifically (not a higher-level component such as Layout or DocPage) to add the banner below the footer

checklist.name: No eject pattern
checklist.description: The Footer wrapper file does NOT contain large blocks of original Docusaurus Footer implementation code (copyright links, social icons rendering, etc.) that would indicate a full eject was performed
